newsitem.title: CHINA: China Venturetech Inv completes US$27 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China Venturetech Inv completes US$27 mln loan.

text.p: China Venturetech Investment Corp has completed a US$27 million transferable term loan facility with nine financial institutions, arranger IBJ Asia said on Wednesday.
The facility was increased to US$27 million from the original US$23 million, the arranger said.
It has a maturity of 1,457 days with put options on the 364th, 728th and 1,093th day. The interest margin is 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
A Letter of Support is provided from China's State Commission for Science and Technology.
Eight financial institutions in addition to the arranger joined the syndication.

Hanil Bank's Shanghai branch, Malayan Banking Berhad, Arab Banking Corp's Singapore branch, Banco Central Hispanoamericano's Hongkong branch, Bank of East Asia's Dalian branch, Industrial Bank of Korea's Hongkong branch, KEXIM Asia and Kookmin Finance Asia are the co-arrangers.
